description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of the length of the gold prefix for two different conditions: a baseline (represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers) and an inconsistency condition labeled "Inconsistency: wait-9" (represented by a red solid line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," ranges from 0 to 20, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 23 to 29, with major tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line begins at a BLEU score of approximately 24.7 when the gold prefix length is 0, dips to a low of about 23.7 at a length of 1, and then exhibits a general upward trend, reaching a peak of approximately 28.0 at a length of 20. The red solid line starts at a BLEU score of about 25.0 at a length of 0, fluctuates between approximately 25.0 and 26.0 for most of the range, and ends at a BLEU score of about 25.9 at a length of 20. The two lines cross at a gold prefix length of approximately 7, where both have a BLEU score of about 25.5.
